rows.quote: Logistic regression was used to estimate exome protein score association with cancer risk in UKBB and replication analyses were performed in the Multiethnic Cohort (MEC).

rows.quote: We additionally performed an inverse-variance weighted meta-analysis combining associations for these proteins estimated in EPIC with those in 21,481 men from UK Biobank (UKBB), of whom 1,147 developed prostate cancer.
